text.p: -- Bear Stearns analyst Eric Blachno reiterated his buy rating on 3Com Corp, maintained his previous earnings estimates and said the stock's current weakness should be viewed as a buying opportunity.

-- The analyst said he believed that the weakness described by the company in a meeting with Wall Street analysts Tuesday was a temporary phenomenon during December and that revenues appear to be strong in January according to his own checks.
-- Blachno said he stands by his $0.63 per share estimate for the fiscal third quarter ending in February.

-- Blachno said the company had described weak sales in its network adapter card business, which accounts for an estimated 40 pct of 3Com's total revenues, and in the stackable hubs, segment, another network equipment business that totals about 15 to 20 percent of 3Com's overall revenues.
-- The sales weakness was concentrated in its indirect sales channels, which account for about 60 to 65 percent of the company's distribution, according to Blachno's estimate.
-- "We think the marketplace continues to be stong," Blachno said. "We think it is actually improving," he added.
-- "We expect volatility in this space (in the near-term)" he said, but added that, "We view the weakness in the shares as a buying opportunity."
-- Blachno said his buy rating is the equivalent of a strong buy at other firms. He stood by his 12-month price target of $90 on 3Com stock.
